motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Background and console border changes; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: holding-pulse
motion.purpose: Console open holding span during an active run only; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Start fresh run
components.css: .ds-start { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; min-height:48px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--accent, #50d9f3); border-radius:6px; background:var(--accent, #50d9f3); color:#06232c; font:750 14px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-start:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#89e9f8; } .ds-start:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #50d9f3); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-start:active:not(:disabled) { background:#2fc1dd; } .ds-start:disabled { background:var(--panel, #101923); color:var(--dim, #8d9bad); border-color:var(--border, #304154); cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-start { transition:none; } }

components.name: Secondary transport
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; min-height:44px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--control-border, #526b82); border-radius:6px; background:var(--raised, #172330); color:var(--fg, #edf4fa); font:600 13px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--hover, #203247); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #50d9f3); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background:#2a4158; } .ds-secondary:disabled { background:var(--panel, #101923); color:var(--dim, #8d9bad); border-color:var(--border, #304154); cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Backend URL
components.description: Native URL field in the setup inspector.
components.html: <label class="ds-url-label">Backend URL<input class="ds-url" type="url" value="http://127.0.0.1:8765" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off"></label>
components.css: .ds-url-label { display:grid; gap:8px; color:var(--muted, #9cabbc); font:12px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-url { min-width:0; min-height:44px; padding:10px 11px; border:1px solid var(--control-border, #526b82); border-radius:6px; background:var(--bg, #090e14); color:var(--fg, #edf4fa); caret-color:var(--accent, #50d9f3); font:12px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-url:hover { border-color:#8197ad; } .ds-url:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #50d9f3); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-url:disabled { color:var(--muted, #9cabbc); border-color:var(--border, #304154); }

components.name: Connection status
components.description: Text and status dot remain paired.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-block; border:1px solid var(--border, #304154); border-radius:6px; padding:7px 9px; color:var(--fg, #edf4fa); background:var(--panel, #101923); font:11px/1.45 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-chip::before { content:''; display:inline-block; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; margin:0 7px 1px 0; background:var(--silence, #63758a); }

components.name: Call monitor
components.description: Flat monitor surface with a named state and event time.
components.html:
Call monitor

No run00:00.00
EVENT TIME

Connect a source. Give every turn room.
components.css: .ds-monitor { padding:18px 22px 20px; border:1px solid var(--border, #304154); border-radius:12px; background:var(--panel, #101923); color:var(--fg, #edf4fa); } .ds-monitor h2 { margin:0; font:650 15px/1.5 Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-tally { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:space-between; gap:18px; margin-top:14px; padding:20px 0 24px; border-top:2px solid var(--silence, #63758a); } .ds-tally strong { color:#c3d0de; font:760 64px/.98 Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.035em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-tally span { color:var(--muted, #9cabbc); font:11px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-monitor p { margin:0; color:var(--muted, #9cabbc); font:13px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Configuration tile
components.description: Native radio with selected border and fill.
components.css: .ds-config { display:grid; grid-template-columns:17px minmax(0,1fr); gap:4px 10px; padding:12px; border:1px solid var(--border, #304154); border-radius:6px; color:var(--fg, #edf4fa); background:var(--panel, #101923); cursor:pointer; } .ds-config:has(input:checked) { background:var(--selected, #12303d); border-color:var(--accent, #50d9f3); } .ds-config:hover { background:var(--raised, #172330); border-color:#8197ad; } .ds-config:has(input:checked):hover { background:var(--selected, #12303d); border-color:var(--accent, #50d9f3); } .ds-config input { margin:0; width:16px; height:16px; accent-color:var(--accent, #50d9f3); } .ds-config input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #50d9f3); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-config span { font:700 14px Archivo, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing:.01em; } .ds-config small { grid-column:2; color:var(--muted, #9cabbc); font:12px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Mobile setup jump
components.description: Mobile access to the inspector below the monitor.
components.css: .ds-setup { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--control-border, #526b82); border-radius:6px; background:var(--raised, #172330); color:var(--accent, #50d9f3); text-decoration:none; font:600 13px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-setup:hover { background:var(--hover, #203247); } .ds-setup:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #50d9f3); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
A cool charcoal operating workspace with cyan transport controls, semantic event color, and explicit provenance. Source selection and run transport sit above the main monitor; configuration and connection controls sit in a right inspector. The large tally and shared timeline provide an immediate reading while the run record and ledger keep the underlying events inspectable.

This document specializes the [shared studio design](../DESIGN.md), selected on 2026-10-10. It records [styles.css](styles.css), [index.html](index.html), and [app.js](app.js). The [root sidecar](../../.impeccable/design.json) describes the complete visual system; the [console sidecar](.impeccable/design.json) contains its local component previews. Derived preview ramps do not add production tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Source and transport above a dominant event monitor.
A right setup inspector with native configuration and connection controls.
Precise source-relative time, readable overflow, and visible provenance.
Cool tonal layers, cyan focus, and labeled semantic state color.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color has a text label; overlap also uses hatching and an onset marker when its end is unknown.

rules.name: The Event Time Rule
rules.body: The console clock follows the latest reported source timestamp. It is not an animated playback clock.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Separate working areas with tone, spacing, and borders; reserve bright color for an action or a labeled state.

dos: **Do** keep source selection, transport, setup access, and provenance easy to find.
**Do** preserve native controls, visible focus, shortcuts, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** label fixture views synthetic, no audio, and not evidence.
**Do** keep scrollable timeline and ledger content reachable by keyboard.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce warm neutral tokens or a monochrome primary transport.
**Don't** draw a waveform without real waveform data.
**Don't** give an unknown interval a known endpoint or duration.
**Don't** present backend audio receipt as verified speaker playback.
